units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>מה השמן … מְזַֹרְזֵף בשאר … מְזַרְזְפִים וכ׳</he> (not <he>כשאר</he>) as oil on top of another liquid, when the cup is full, does not flow over with other liquids, so will the words of the Law not flow over (the lips) in connection with words of frivolity.
